Gold-sql: WITH sorted_values AS ( SELECT Gender, HetRateAuto FROM HUMAN_GENOME_VARIANTS.SIMONS_GENOME_DIVERSITY_PROJECT_SAMPLE_METADATA ORDER BY Gender, HetRateAuto ), gender_arrays AS ( SELECT Gender, JSON_ARRAYAGG(HetRateAuto) AS values_array, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sorted_values GROUP BY Gender ), gender_percentiles AS ( SELECT Gender, CAST(IF( ABS((cnt-1)*0.3 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3)) < 1e-9, JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3), ']')), JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3), ']')) * (1 - ((cnt-1)*0.3 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3))) + JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', CEIL((cnt-1)*0.3), ']')) * (((cnt-1)*0.3 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.3))) ) AS FLOAT) AS p30, CAST(IF( ABS((cnt-1)*0.7 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7)) < 1e-9, JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7), ']')), JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7), ']')) * (1 - ((cnt-1)*0.7 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7))) + JSON_EXTRACT(values_array, CONCAT('$[', CEIL((cnt-1)*0.7), ']')) * (((cnt-1)*0.7 - FLOOR((cnt-1)*0.7))) ) AS FLOAT) AS p70 FROM gender_arrays ) SELECT t.Gender, t.Population_ID, t.HetRateAuto, t.Region, t.Country FROM HUMAN_GENOME_VARIANTS.SIMONS_GENOME_DIVERSITY_PROJECT_SAMPLE_METADATA t JOIN gender_percentiles gp ON t.Gender = gp.Gender WHERE t.HetRateAuto BETWEEN LEAST(gp.p30, gp.p70) AND GREATEST(gp.p30, gp.p70);
pred-sql: WITH population_gender_het AS ( SELECT Gender, Population_ID, AVG(HetRateAuto) AS avg_het_rate_auto FROM simons_genome_diversity_project_sample_metadata WHERE HetRateAuto IS NOT NULL AND Gender IS NOT NULL AND Population_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Gender, Population_ID ), ranked_populations AS ( SELECT Gender, Population_ID, avg_het_rate_auto, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Gender ORDER BY avg_het_rate_auto) AS pct_rank FROM population_gender_het ) SELECT Gender, Population_ID, avg_het_rate_auto FROM ranked_populations WHERE pct_rank BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.7 ORDER BY Gender, avg_het_rate_auto
Effective diff desc: gold_sql计算每个性别HetRateAuto的30%和70%分位数，筛选个体值落在该范围内的记录；pred_sql计算每个性别+人群组合的HetRateAuto平均值，再筛选平均值在30%-70%百分位排名的人群，两者统计逻辑和筛选对象完全不同

pred-sql: WITH type_max_dp AS ( SELECT CONCAT(reference_bases, '>', alternate_bases) AS variant_type, MAX(DP) AS max_dp FROM mnpr01_201703 WHERE DP IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CONCAT(reference_bases, '>', alternate_bases) ) SELECT m.variant_id FROM mnpr01_201703 m JOIN type_max_dp t ON CONCAT(m.reference_bases, '>', m.alternate_bases) = t.variant_type AND m.DP = t.max_dp WHERE m.DP IS NOT NULL;

Gold-sql: WITH category_stats AS ( SELECT TYPE AS Category, AVG(AF) AS avg_measure, SUM(AF) AS total_measure FROM GENOMICS_CANNABIS.MNPR01_201703 GROUP BY TYPE ), ranked AS ( SELECT t.TYPE AS Category, t.variant_id AS Entity, t.AF AS Measure, cs.avg_measure, cs.total_measure, t.AF / cs.total_measure * 100 AS pct_of_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.TYPE ORDER BY t.AF / cs.total_measure DESC) AS rn FROM GENOMICS_CANNABIS.MNPR01_201703 t JOIN category_stats cs ON t.TYPE = cs.Category WHERE t.AF > cs.avg_measure ) SELECT Category, Entity, pct_of_total FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5;

pred-sql: WITH ordered_variants AS ( SELECT TYPE, reference_name, variant_id, start, DP, LAG(DP) OVER (PARTITION BY TYPE, reference_name ORDER BY start) AS prev_dp FROM mnpr01_201703 WHERE DP IS NOT NULL AND start IS NOT NULL AND reference_name IS NOT NULL ), depth_jumps AS ( SELECT TYPE, reference_name, variant_id, start, DP, prev_dp, (DP - prev_dp) AS depth_jump FROM ordered_variants WHERE prev_dp IS NOT NULL AND DP > prev_dp ), ranked_jumps AS ( SELECT TYPE, reference_name, variant_id, start, depth_jump, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TYPE ORDER BY depth_jump DESC) AS rn FROM depth_jumps ) SELECT TYPE, reference_name, variant_id, start, depth_jump FROM ranked_jumps WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY TYPE, depth_jump DESC

question: 我想排查 NuGet 包依赖声明里有没有出现“good”这类关键词（比如某个包名/框架标识）。把最近一次快照里命中的版本先给我前 10 个。
Gold-sql: SELECT nr.Version AS id_external FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.NUGETREQUIREMENTS nr WHERE CAST(nr.DependencyGroups AS CHAR) LIKE '%good%' ORDER BY nr.SnapshotAt DESC LIMIT 10;
pred-sql:
SELECT DISTINCT nr.Name, nr.Version, nr.SnapshotAt
FROM nugetrequirements nr
WHERE nr.SnapshotAt = (SELECT MAX(s.Time) FROM snapshots s)
  AND (
    nr.Name LIKE '%good%'
    OR nr.DependencyGroups LIKE '%good%'
  )
LIMIT 10
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL多选了Name和SnapshotAt两列，并使用了DISTINCT；过滤条件增加了SnapshotAt必须等于最新快照时间，且额外允许Name包含'good'，同时未对DependencyGroups做CAST转字符处理；缺少ORDER BY SnapshotAt DESC排序，导致TOP10选取逻辑与Gold SQL不一致。

Gold-sql: SELECT x.tag AS category_topic, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN x.accepted = False THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS ratio_in_status FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ZILLIQA_TRANSITIONS x WHERE x.block_timestamp >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2001-01-01 00:00:00') * 1000000.0 AND x.block_timestamp < UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-01-31 23:59:59') * 1000000.0 GROUP BY x.tag ORDER BY ratio_in_status DESC LIMIT 10;
pred-sql: SELECT t.tag AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt, AVG(CASE WHEN t.accepted = FALSE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_ratio, AVG(CASE WHEN t.accepted = TRUE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS acceptance_rate FROM crypto_zilliqa_transitions t WHERE t.block_timestamp >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND t.block_timestamp < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY t.tag ORDER BY acceptance_rate DESC LIMIT 10
Effective diff desc: pred_sql计算的是acceptance_rate（接受率）并升序排列，而gold_sql计算的是rejected_ratio（拒绝率）并降序排列，两者排序指标相反；且pred_sql使用字符串时间戳比较，gold_sql使用UNIX_TIMESTAMP转换后的微秒时间戳，时间范围过滤条件不等价；pred_sql还额外返回了event_cnt和rejected_ratio列，与gold_sql的列集合不一致

Effective diff desc: pred_sql返回的是教师姓名而gold_sql返回的是教师编号FacNo，且pred_sql未加DISTINCT可能导致同一教师不同编号被合并，同时pred_sql缺少表名前缀EDUCATION_BUSINESS且年份条件未加引号

Gold-sql: WITH daily AS ( SELECT DATE( t.PLAN_ARRIVE_TIME) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `IOC_NaturalGas`.`NG_LNG_SHIP` t WHERE CAST(t.PLAN_ARRIVE_TIME AS DATETIME) >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND CAST(t.PLAN_ARRIVE_TIME AS DATETIME) < '2020-01-08 00:00:00' GROUP BY d ), ma AS ( SELECT d, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_7d_avg FROM daily ) SELECT d, cnt, prev_7d_avg FROM ma WHERE prev_7d_avg IS NOT NULL AND cnt > prev_7d_avg ORDER BY (cnt - prev_7d_avg) DESC;
pred-sql:
WITH daily_cnt AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(t.PLANNED_ARRIVAL_TIME) AS arrival_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_cnt
    FROM ng_future_lng_shipping_schedule t
    WHERE t.PLANNED_ARRIVAL_TIME >= '2019-12-25'
      AND t.PLANNED_ARRIVAL_TIME < '2020-01-08'
      AND (t.DEL_FLAG IS NULL OR t.DEL_FLAG <> 1)
    GROUP BY DATE(t.PLANNED_ARRIVAL_TIME)
), baseline AS (
    SELECT
        d.arrival_date,
        d.daily_cnt,
        AVG(d.daily_cnt) OVER (
            ORDER BY d.arrival_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prev_7d_avg,
        SUM(d.daily_cnt) OVER (
            ORDER BY d.arrival_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prev_7d_sum
    FROM daily_cnt d
)
SELECT
    b.arrival_date,
    b.daily_cnt,
    ROUND(b.prev_7d_avg, 2) AS prev_7d_avg,
    ROUND(b.daily_cnt - b.prev_7d_avg, 2) AS excess_cnt,
    ROUND(b.daily_cnt / NULLIF(b.prev_7d_avg, 0), 2) AS spike_ratio
FROM baseline b
WHERE b.arrival_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-07'
ORDER BY spike_ratio DESC, excess_cnt DESC, b.arrival_date

question: 我想比较 2023 年 4 月 1 日到 3 日、以及 4 月 6 日到 7 日这两个时间段里，不同页面类型的平衡记录活跃度变化，先看前 3 类变化最明显的页面类型
Gold-sql: SELECT t.page_type, SUM(CASE WHEN t.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN t.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06 00:00:00' AND t.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_cnt, ( SUM(CASE WHEN t.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06 00:00:00' AND t.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) AS delta_cnt FROM Refinery.balance_information t WHERE t.page_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.page_type ORDER BY delta_cnt DESC LIMIT 3;
pred-sql:
SELECT
  b.page_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_20230401_20230403,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_20230406_20230407,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS change_value
FROM balance_information b
WHERE b.page_type IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    (b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04')
    OR
    (b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08')
  )
GROUP BY b.page_type
ORDER BY ABS(change_value) DESC
LIMIT 3

Gold-sql: WITH daily AS ( SELECT DATE( t.begin_shift_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Refinery.balance_information t WHERE t.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00' GROUP BY d ), ma AS ( SELECT d, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_7d_avg FROM daily ) SELECT d, cnt, prev_7d_avg FROM ma WHERE prev_7d_avg IS NOT NULL AND cnt > prev_7d_avg ORDER BY (cnt - prev_7d_avg) DESC LIMIT 3;
pred-sql:
WITH daily_cnt AS (
    SELECT DATE(b.begin_shift_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS day_record_cnt
    FROM balance_information b
    WHERE b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01 00:00:00'
      AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY DATE(b.begin_shift_time)
)
SELECT 
    d.stat_date,
    d.day_record_cnt,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*) / 7.0
        FROM balance_information b2
        WHERE b2.begin_shift_time >= DATE_SUB(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
          AND b2.begin_shift_time < d.stat_date
    ) AS prior_7d_avg_record_cnt,
    d.day_record_cnt - (
        SELECT COUNT(*) / 7.0
        FROM balance_information b3
        WHERE b3.begin_shift_time >= DATE_SUB(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
          AND b3.begin_shift_time < d.stat_date
    ) AS uplift_vs_prior_7d_avg
FROM daily_cnt d
ORDER BY uplift_vs_prior_7d_avg DESC
LIMIT 3

pred-sql: SELECT p.promo_category, SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_period_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 20 AND 31 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS second_period_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 20 AND 31 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_cnt FROM sales s JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND (t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 1 AND 10 OR t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 20 AND 31) GROUP BY p.promo_category HAVING first_period_cnt > second_period_cnt ORDER BY diff_cnt DESC, p.promo_category LIMIT 3

pred-sql: SELECT p.promo_category, SUM( CASE WHEN s.time_id >= '2019-03-01' AND s.time_id <= '2019-03-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS curr_cnt, SUM( CASE WHEN s.time_id >= '2019-03-20' AND s.time_id <= '2019-03-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_cnt, ( SUM( CASE WHEN s.time_id >= '2019-03-01' AND s.time_id <= '2019-03-10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) - SUM( CASE WHEN s.time_id >= '2019-03-20' AND s.time_id <= '2019-03-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) ) AS delta_cnt FROM SALES s JOIN PROMOTIONS p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id WHERE p.promo_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.promo_category ORDER BY delta_cnt DESC LIMIT 3;
Effective diff desc: 时间过滤条件不等价：gold_sql使用CAST转DATE后'< 2019-03-11'和'< 2019-04-01'，而pred_sql直接使用字符串比较'<='，且缺少CAST转换；另外pred_sql多了WHERE p.promo_category IS NOT NULL过滤条件

question: 在 2019 年 3 月上旬这个指定周期里，各类促销分别吃掉了多少销售额份额？我想看收入结构是怎么分布的。
Gold-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT p.promo_category AS topic, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amt FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id WHERE CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-01' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-03-11' GROUP BY p.promo_category ), tot AS ( SELECT SUM(amt) AS total_amt FROM agg ) SELECT topic, amt, amt / NULLIF((SELECT total_amt FROM tot), 0) AS amt_share FROM agg ORDER BY amt_share DESC;

Effective diff desc: pred_sql缺少表名前缀COMPLEX_ORACLE，且时间过滤条件从日期范围比较改为通过times表关联过滤，同时增加了p.promo_category IS NOT NULL过滤条件，导致语义不等价

question: 我想在 2019 年 3 月 20 日到 31 日这段时间里，找出销售记录数高于此前一段时间平均水平的日期，先看差值最大的 3 天。
Gold-sql: WITH daily AS ( SELECT DATE( CAST(s.time_id AS DATE)) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.CUSTOMERS c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-20' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-04-01' GROUP BY d ), ma AS ( SELECT d, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_7d_avg FROM daily ) SELECT d, cnt, prev_7d_avg FROM ma WHERE prev_7d_avg IS NOT NULL AND cnt > prev_7d_avg ORDER BY (cnt - prev_7d_avg) DESC LIMIT 3;
pred-sql: WITH prior_daily AS ( SELECT t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, t.day_number_in_month, COUNT(*) AS daily_sales FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 1 AND 19 GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, t.day_number_in_month ), prior_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(daily_sales) AS avg_daily_sales FROM prior_daily ), target_daily AS ( SELECT t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, t.day_number_in_month, COUNT(*) AS daily_sales FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 20 AND 31 GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, t.day_number_in_month ) SELECT CONCAT(td.calendar_year, '-', LPAD(td.calendar_month_number, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(td.day_number_in_month, 2, '0')) AS sale_date, td.daily_sales, pa.avg_daily_sales, td.daily_sales - pa.avg_daily_sales AS diff_from_prior_avg FROM target_daily td CROSS JOIN prior_avg pa WHERE td.daily_sales > pa.avg_daily_sales ORDER BY diff_from_prior_avg DESC, sale_date ASC LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: gold_sql计算的是目标日期与其前7天移动平均的比较，pred_sql计算的是目标日期与整个3月1-19日整体平均的比较，且pred_sql未使用CUSTOMERS表连接导致数据源不同，两者比较基准完全不同
